distance_rule: Sum each frozen temperature-adjusted model probability times the accepted label up+down meiosis count; no new model fitting, calibrator, prior correction, threshold or tuning. Encode r=2**(1-mean) solely to reuse the frozen NJ decoder distance API d=1-log2(r). Synthetic r is not observed IBD or measured kinship.
structural_policy: Frozen neighbor joining, integer edge conversion, accepted-label valid roots, composite log score, ties and no-valid-root fallback. No truth, age, midpoint, generation or topology oracle enters inference.
cohorts: The same eight v2 development cohorts, now explicitly reused development data. All prior results retained. Old reserved confirmation and nested qualification remain untouched.
uncertainty: No root posterior or calibrated-root-confidence claim. Return only exploratory labels and retain complete valid-root ambiguity.

tests.checks: Exact mean-distance inversion, complete probability validation, exact deterministic tree recovery and input pair/order invariance; preceding component and phase invariants retained.
